package httptransport

import (
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/usecase"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

const (
	maximumCommandBytes = 64 << 10
	maximumReviewBytes  = 16 << 10
)

type Server struct {
	Runtime       *usecase.Runtime
	InternalToken string
	TeacherToken  string
}

type revisionSummaryV2 struct {
	Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
	RevisionID            string    `json:"revision_id"`
	RevisionDigest        string    `json:"revision_digest"`
	FamilyKey             string    `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey            string    `json:"variant_key"`
	RevisionNumber        int       `json:"revision_number"`
	SurfaceClassification string    `json:"surface_classification"`
	ScenarioTitle         string    `json:"scenario_title"`
	TaskType              string    `json:"task_type"`
	PublishedAt           time.Time `json:"published_at"`
}

func revisionSummaryDTO(summary domain.RevisionSummary) revisionSummaryV2 {
	return revisionSummaryV2{Schema: summary.Schema, RevisionID: summary.RevisionID, RevisionDigest: summary.Digest,
		FamilyKey: summary.FamilyKey, VariantKey: summary.VariantKey, RevisionNumber: summary.RevisionNumber,
		SurfaceClassification: summary.Surface, ScenarioTitle: summary.Title, TaskType: summary.Type,
		PublishedAt: summary.PublishedAt.UTC()}
}

func writeStartResult(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, result domain.StartResult) {
	writeJSON(writer, status, struct {
		Schema   string              `json:"schema"`
		Instance domain.TaskInstance `json:"instance"`
		Revision revisionSummaryV2   `json:"revision"`
	}{result.Schema, result.Instance, revisionSummaryDTO(result.Revision)})
}

func (server *Server) Handler() http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /healthz", func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/project-instances", server.start("project"))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/practice-instances", server.start("practice"))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v2/task-instances", server.listInstances)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}", server.getInstance)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/workspace", server.getWorkspace)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/steps/{stepID}/materialize", server.materialize)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/steps/{stepID}/readiness-reconciliations", server.reconcileStepReadiness)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/steps/{stepID}/checkpoints", server.checkpoint)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/submissions", server.submit)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/submissions", server.listSubmissions)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/submissions/{submissionID}", server.getSubmission)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/submissions/{submissionID}/review", server.review)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/cancel", server.cancel)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/provisioning/retry", server.requireInternal(server.retryProvisioning))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/v2/validation-runs/{runID}/retry", server.requireInternal(server.retryValidation))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/v2/task-instances/{instanceID}/execution-projection", server.requireInternal(server.executionProjection))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/task-instances/{instanceID}/teacher-context", server.requireTeacher(server.teacherContext))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/task-instances/{instanceID}/teacher-validation-explanation", server.requireTeacher(server.teacherValidation))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/task-instances/{instanceID}/teacher-assistance", server.requireTeacher(server.teacherAssistance))
	return noStore(mux)
}

type startRequest struct {
	Schema             string `json:"schema"`
	TaskRevisionID     string `json:"task_revision_id"`
	Locale             string `json:"locale"`
	SolutionVariantID  string `json:"solution_variant_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID     string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID      string `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
}

func (server *Server) start(surface string) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
		if !ok {
			return
		}
		var payload startRequest
		if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumCommandBytes); err != nil || payload.Schema != domain.StartSchema {
			writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
			return
		}
		idempotencyKey := request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
		result, status, err := server.Runtime.Start(request.Context(), domain.StartCommand{StudentID: studentID,
			IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, TaskRevisionID: payload.TaskRevisionID, Locale: payload.Locale,
			SurfaceClassification: surface, SolutionVariantID: payload.SolutionVariantID, LearningPathID: payload.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: payload.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: payload.RequirementID})
		if err != nil {
			writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
			return
		}
		writeStartResult(writer, status, result)
	}
}

func (server *Server) listInstances(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	limit, err := parseLimit(request.URL.Query().Get("limit"), 50)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	status := domain.TaskInstanceStatus(request.URL.Query().Get("status"))
	if status != "" && !validTaskStatus(status) {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	items, next, err := server.Runtime.List(request.Context(), studentID, request.URL.Query().Get("cursor"), limit, status)
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, struct {
		Schema     string                `json:"schema"`
		Items      []domain.TaskInstance `json:"items"`
		NextCursor string                `json:"next_cursor,omitempty"`
	}{"practice-task-instance-list.v2", items, next})
}

func (server *Server) getInstance(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	result, err := server.Runtime.GetDetail(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeStartResult(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (server *Server) getWorkspace(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	result, err := server.Runtime.GetDetail(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, struct {
		Schema      string              `json:"schema"`
		Instance    domain.TaskInstance `json:"instance"`
		Revision    revisionSummaryV2   `json:"revision"`
		CurrentStep *domain.Step        `json:"current_step,omitempty"`
		Progress    domain.Progress     `json:"progress"`
	}{"practice-task-workspace.v2", result.Instance, revisionSummaryDTO(result.Revision), result.Instance.CurrentStep, result.Instance.Progress})
}

func (server *Server) materialize(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	if err := decodeEmpty(writer, request); err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, err := server.Runtime.Materialize(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"), request.PathValue("stepID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusCreated
	if result.Replayed {
		status = http.StatusOK
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, result.Value)
}

func (server *Server) reconcileStepReadiness(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		Schema string `json:"schema"`
	}
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumCommandBytes); err != nil || payload.Schema != "practice-step-readiness-reconcile.v1" {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, status, err := server.Runtime.ReconcileStepReadiness(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"), request.PathValue("stepID"), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, result)
}

func (server *Server) checkpoint(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	stepID := request.PathValue("stepID")
	payload, err := decodeCheckpointRequest(writer, request, stepID)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, status, err := server.Runtime.Submit(request.Context(), domain.SubmitCommand{TaskInstanceID: request.PathValue("instanceID"),
		StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), Scope: payload.Scope, MilestoneID: payload.MilestoneID})
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, result)
}

func decodeCheckpointRequest(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request, stepID string) (submitRequest, error) {
	var payload submitRequest
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumCommandBytes); err != nil {
		return submitRequest{}, err
	}
	if payload.Schema != domain.SubmitSchema || payload.Scope != "MILESTONE" || payload.MilestoneID != stepID {
		return submitRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	return payload, nil
}

type submitRequest struct {
	Schema      string `json:"schema"`
	Scope       string `json:"scope"`
	MilestoneID string `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
}

func (server *Server) submit(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	var payload submitRequest
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumCommandBytes); err != nil || payload.Schema != domain.SubmitSchema {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, status, err := server.Runtime.Submit(request.Context(), domain.SubmitCommand{TaskInstanceID: request.PathValue("instanceID"),
		StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), Scope: payload.Scope, MilestoneID: payload.MilestoneID})
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, result)
}

func (server *Server) listSubmissions(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	limit, err := parseLimit(request.URL.Query().Get("limit"), 50)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	items, next, err := server.Runtime.ListSubmissions(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"), request.URL.Query().Get("cursor"), limit)
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, struct {
		Schema     string              `json:"schema"`
		Items      []domain.Submission `json:"items"`
		NextCursor string              `json:"next_cursor,omitempty"`
	}{"practice-task-submission-list.v2", items, next})
}

func (server *Server) getSubmission(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	result, err := server.Runtime.GetSubmission(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"), request.PathValue("submissionID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}

type reviewRequest struct {
	Schema   string `json:"schema"`
	Decision string `json:"decision"`
	Feedback string `json:"feedback"`
}

func (server *Server) review(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	reviewerID := request.Header.Get("X-User-ID")
	role := request.Header.Get("X-User-Role")
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(reviewerID) || (role != "MENTOR" && role != "ADMIN") {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden")
		return
	}
	var payload reviewRequest
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumReviewBytes); err != nil || payload.Schema != "practice-human-review-decision.v1" {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, status, err := server.Runtime.Review(request.Context(), request.PathValue("instanceID"), request.PathValue("submissionID"), reviewerID, payload.Decision, payload.Feedback)
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, result)
}

type cancelRequest struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

func (server *Server) cancel(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, ok := requireStudent(writer, request)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	var payload cancelRequest
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumCommandBytes); err != nil || payload.Schema != "practice-task-instance-cancel.v1" {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, status, err := server.Runtime.Cancel(request.Context(), studentID, request.PathValue("instanceID"), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), payload.Reason)
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, result)
}

func (server *Server) retryProvisioning(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if err := decodeEmpty(writer, request); err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, status, err := server.Runtime.RetryProvisioning(request.Context(), request.PathValue("instanceID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, status, err)
		return
	}
	writeStartResult(writer, status, result)
}

func (server *Server) retryValidation(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if err := decodeEmpty(writer, request); err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, err := server.Runtime.RetryValidation(request.Context(), request.PathValue("runID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusAccepted, result)
}

func (server *Server) teacherContext(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := request.URL.Query().Get("student_id")
	result, err := server.Runtime.TeacherContext(request.Context(), request.PathValue("instanceID"), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (server *Server) teacherValidation(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := request.URL.Query().Get("student_id")
	result, err := server.Runtime.TeacherValidation(request.Context(), request.PathValue("instanceID"), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}

type teacherAssistanceRequest struct {
	UsageID    string `json:"usage_id"`
	StudentID  string `json:"student_id"`
	Assistance struct {
		Schema    string `json:"schema"`
		StepID    string `json:"step_id"`
		Kind      string `json:"kind"`
		HintLevel int    `json:"hint_level,omitempty"`
	} `json:"assistance"`
}

// Teacher consumes this bounded HTTP receipt; the stored assistance receipt
// retains its versioned schema, usage_id, and occurred_at fields.
type teacherAssistanceResponse struct {
	ID             string    `json:"id"`
	TaskInstanceID string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID      string    `json:"student_id"`
	StepID         string    `json:"step_id"`
	Kind           string    `json:"kind"`
	HintLevel      int       `json:"hint_level,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion  string    `json:"policy_version"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

func (server *Server) teacherAssistance(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload teacherAssistanceRequest
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &payload, maximumReviewBytes); err != nil {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	result, err := server.Runtime.RecordAssistance(request.Context(), request.PathValue("instanceID"), ports.AssistanceReceipt{
		Schema: payload.Assistance.Schema, UsageID: payload.UsageID, StudentID: payload.StudentID,
		TaskInstanceID: request.PathValue("instanceID"), StepID: payload.Assistance.StepID,
		Kind: payload.Assistance.Kind, HintLevel: payload.Assistance.HintLevel})
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, teacherAssistanceResponse{
		ID: result.UsageID, TaskInstanceID: result.TaskInstanceID, StudentID: result.StudentID,
		StepID: result.StepID, Kind: result.Kind, HintLevel: result.HintLevel,
		PolicyVersion: result.PolicyVersion, CreatedAt: result.OccurredAt,
	})
}

func (server *Server) requireInternal(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if !validToken(request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"), server.InternalToken) {
			writeError(writer, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
			return
		}
		next(writer, request)
	}
}

func (server *Server) requireTeacher(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if !validToken(request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"), server.TeacherToken) {
			writeError(writer, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
			return
		}
		next(writer, request)
	}
}

func requireStudent(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) (string, bool) {
	studentID, role := request.Header.Get("X-User-ID"), request.Header.Get("X-User-Role")
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(studentID) || (role != "STUDENT" && role != "STUDENT_PRO") {
		writeError(writer, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden")
		return "", false
	}
	return studentID, true
}

func validToken(given, expected string) bool {
	return given != "" && expected != "" && len(given) == len(expected) && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(given), []byte(expected)) == 1
}

func decodeStrict(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request, result any, maximum int64) error {
	if request.Body == nil {
		return errors.New("missing request body")
	}
	mediaType := strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(request.Header.Get("Content-Type"), ";")[0])
	if mediaType != "application/json" {
		return errors.New("application/json is required")
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, maximum))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(result); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("request must contain exactly one JSON value")
	}
	return nil
}

func decodeEmpty(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) error {
	var empty struct{}
	if err := decodeStrict(writer, request, &empty, 8<<10); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func parseLimit(value string, defaultValue int) (int, error) {
	if value == "" {
		return defaultValue, nil
	}
	limit, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
	if err != nil || limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("limit must be between 1 and 100")
	}
	return limit, nil
}

func validTaskStatus(status domain.TaskInstanceStatus) bool {
	switch status {
	case domain.TaskInstanceStarting, domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, domain.TaskInstanceValidating, domain.TaskInstanceInReview,
		domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing, domain.TaskInstanceCompleted, domain.TaskInstanceCancelled:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func writeUsecaseError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, err error) {
	code := "unavailable"
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalid) {
		code, status = "invalid_request", http.StatusBadRequest
	} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrAuthoringDefect) {
		code, status = "invalid_revision", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
	} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrVariantRequired) {
		code, status = "variant_required", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
	} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		code, status = "not_found", http.StatusNotFound
	} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrIdempotency) {
		code, status = "idempotency_conflict", http.StatusConflict
	} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		code, status = "conflict", http.StatusConflict
	} else if status == 0 {
		status = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
	}
	if status == 0 {
		status = http.StatusInternalServerError
	}
	writeError(writer, status, code)
}

func writeError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	writeJSON(writer, status, map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}

func writeJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(value)
}

func noStore(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		next.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
	})
}
